title: Scorpio Emoji ♏ Meaning: Intense, Secretive, Stinger Out
description: The ♏ Scorpio emoji is the zodiac sign of the Scorpion, October 23 to November 21. See why it signals intensity and mystery, and how it differs from ♍.
summary: The ♏ Scorpio emoji is the symbol for Scorpio, the Scorpion, the zodiac sign of people born from about October 23 to November 21. It states a sign and carries the sign's reputation: intense, private, passionate, and not quick to forgive.
meaning: You can spot the Scorpio glyph by its tail. It is an m-shaped figure whose final stroke kicks outward and ends in an arrowhead, representing the scorpion's stinger. That detail separates it from the similar Virgo symbol. As an emoji it identifies the eighth zodiac sign in bios, birthday posts, and horoscopes.

Scorpio has the darkest brand in pop astrology. It is a fixed water sign, traditionally ruled by Mars and, in modern astrology, by Pluto. Astrologers speak of depth, loyalty, and emotional intensity; memes speak of grudges, jealousy, secrets, and smoldering stares. The sign is also the one most associated with sex, and "Scorpio energy" can describe someone magnetic or someone you should not cross.

Scorpios tend to enjoy the notoriety. Posting ♏ with 🖤 or 🦂 says "I am exactly as intense as you have heard." Friends use it to explain a person who remembers every slight or who investigates a new partner's entire online history. The season runs through Halloween, which reinforces the spooky image, and the rapper Drake, born in late October, named his 2018 album Scorpion after his sign.

contexts.label: On social media
contexts.body: "Scorpio season" posts begin in late October with moody photos, dark outfits, and captions about transformation. Astrology pages rank Scorpio at the top of lists about loyalty and revenge alike. The emoji is common in usernames of people who adopt the sign as a personality.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: Typical uses: explaining why someone went quiet instead of arguing, confessing to some light detective work on an ex, or warning a friend about a new love interest's sign. It can also be a proud label for all-or-nothing commitment to a person or project.

contexts.label: From a crush
contexts.body: A date who tells you they are a ♏ usually knows the reputation and is being a little provocative. Astrology fans expect Scorpios to be guarded at first and devoted later. The emoji is not a sexual signal by itself, although people do use it to hint at passion.

examples.text: I don't hold grudges, I just remember everything forever ♏
examples.meaning: A Scorpio joking about never forgetting a wrong.
A birthday paired with the sign's dark aesthetic.

examples.text: Found his cousin's wedding photos from 2017 in ten minutes ♏
examples.meaning: The sender is admitting to thorough online sleuthing.

examples.text: Scorpio season ♏ shed the old skin
examples.meaning: A caption about personal change, a theme tied to the sign.

examples.text: Be careful, she's a ♏, do not lie to her
examples.meaning: A playful warning that Scorpios see through dishonesty.

combos.meaning: Passion and magnetism, often with a romantic edge.
The watchful Scorpio who notices everything.

confusedWith.difference: ♍ has the same m body, but its last stroke curls inward into a crossed loop. Scorpio's last stroke points outward with an arrow tip. Mixing them up is the most common zodiac emoji mistake.
🦂 is the arachnid itself, used for deserts, danger, and stinging remarks in addition to the sign. ♏ is the astrological shorthand and refers only to the zodiac.

avoid: Do not label someone ♏ to imply they are vindictive or obsessive unless they enjoy the joke.
Avoid assuming the emoji is a come-on; despite the sign's reputation, it usually just states a birthday.
design: A white m-like glyph with a tail that extends to the right and finishes in an upward-pointing arrowhead, shown on a purple square. Vendors differ only in line thickness and the angle of the arrow. The constellation it refers to is called Scorpius by astronomers, while astrology uses the name Scorpio.

faqs.a: Roughly October 23 to November 21. Scorpio follows Libra and comes before Sagittarius. The exact changeover varies by a day in some years.

Intensity: strong feelings, secrecy, focus, and a certain magnetism. The phrase is used for people or moods that seem deep and slightly dangerous, regardless of actual birth date. It comes from astrological descriptions of the sign.

faqs.q: Which is Scorpio and which is Virgo?
faqs.a: Scorpio, ♏, has the arrow on its tail, like a stinger. Virgo, ♍, ends in a closed loop. Remember "sting for Scorpio" and you will pick the right one.

Water, along with Cancer and Pisces. People are sometimes surprised, since scorpions live in deserts and the sign is described as fiery in temperament, but astrology links water with emotion and depth.
